title: Tag Input
description: An input that turns words into chips — Enter commits, Backspace repents.
usage: For labels, skills, invite lists. Built on the Chip part, so committed tags look and behave exactly like chips everywhere else.
a11y: Chips are removed by real buttons. The input keeps a plain text value for the tag being typed, so nothing is lost if JavaScript is off — it degrades to a comma-separated field.
